thread:
noah: kickoff for tonight's roll — region sequence US -> EU -> APAC. planned window 19:30-22:00 PT. canary steps: 1% -> 4% -> 20% -> full. keep APAC manual until EU completes.
emma: confirmed my alerts are primed. rollback thresholds: error_rate >= 1% sustained over 5m OR token-p95 delta > +120ms over baseline. I'll call rollback on any sustained spike.
raj: warm pool snapshot: US: free=195/300, EU: free=65/120, APAC: free=25/80. APAC has scheduled maintenance at 01:30 local, keep manual hold.
ops-bot: capacity report: us-west-2 free=195 total=300; eu-west-1 free=65 total=120; ap-northeast-1 free=25 total=80. command used: `opsctl report capacity --regions=us,eu,apac`
noah: @deploy-bot start US canary at 1% with version=v1.2.3. pin for canary and leave v1.2.2 as immediate fallback slot.
deploy-bot: canary started: id cb-1729990001 region=us percent=1 version=v1.2.3 fallback=v1.2.2.
clare: enabling KV prefix warmup and cache prefill for canary. payload: `curl -X POST https://internal.api/cache/prefill -d '{"canary":"cb-1729990001","regions":["us"]}'`
emma: 6m check: error_rate=0.05%, p95=205ms, CPU 72% in us pool. green for step after 10m stable.
raj: thermal note: US pools trending but within limits. EU cool. APAC cooling window still the blocker.
deploy-bot: gating: will wait 10m from now before stepping to 4% in US. next status update at +10m.
noah: if any regression, follow staged rollback: cancel canary, promote fallback, and hold EU/APAC. rollback snippet in runbook: `redwoodctl rollout cancel cb-1729990001 && redwoodctl promote --version v1.2.2 --region us`
emma: 11m: US 4% step goes now. monitoring hot metrics closely.
deploy-bot: canary cb-1729990001 stepped to 4% (region=us).
ops-bot: capacity post-step: us free=188/300, eu free=64/120, apac free=25/80. no capacity alerts.
emma: 20m at 4% looks steady. error_rate=0.14%, p95=235ms. I'm OK to open EU at 1% but keep EU under supervised manual hold for 30m.
noah: agree. APAC stays manual. release-manager: prepping announcement for after EU 1% starts. will include rollback contacts and support doc link.
clare: nit: we've toggled cache mode to aggressive for canary; remember to revert cache flags after full rollout.
raj: watch backend retriers — saw a transient 500 -> 429 cascade earlier, not customer-facing.
deploy-bot: EU canary queued; waiting for operator confirmation to execute. manual hold flag remains set for APAC.
release-manager: posting short update to #announcements once EU canary kicks. message: "v1.2.3 rolling update: US at 4% stable; EU staging 1%; APAC manual hold. Follow #eng-releases for live updates."
noah: final note — if any region needs rollback, use staged approach: region-only rollback first, then evaluate cross-region rollback. keep support channel open. next check-in in 25m or immediately if alarms. :eyes:
